invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list (records is always new ArrayList<>()).
clusteringGroup is required to call getSlices(), so it must be non-null on method entry/exit.
result is a List, so its size is always non-negative.
result is returned as a List<HoodieRecord<T>>.
instantTime is passed and used as an argument to downstream methods, so it is expected to be non-null.
